ProductRqmtSpecVersion.name: ProductRqmtSpecVersion
ProductRqmtSpecVersion.description: Represents a specific, numbered snapshot of a Requirement Specification at a particular time, outlining the purpose, scope, constraints, and validation methods. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

ProductRqmtSpec.description: The parent requirement specification that this version belongs to.

Version.description: The version number of a specific requirement specification.

Purpose.description: The key business reason behind the requirement request.

IntendedUse.description: The business or functional goals the product is expected to fulfill.

Scope.description: The defined boundaries, objectives, and context of the requirement or project.

Assumptions.description: The conditions assumed to be true during the design or planning phase.

Constraints.description: The limitations such as time, cost, regulatory, or technical constraints that apply.

VerificationMethod.description: The method used to validate that the requirement has been met

RefProduct.description: The standard product used as a reference or benchmark.

RefProductCategory.description: The product category of the referenced product.

EffectiveDate.description: The date from which this requirement specification is considered valid.

ExpiryDate.description: The date after which this requirement specification is considered obsolete or expired.

ContentDocument.description: The documents attached to support or provide context for the requirement.

AdditionalInfo.description: Any extra details, notes, or instructions for this specific version.
